## Checklist

- [ ] Entry added to **both** `README.md` and `README_zh.md` (Chinese annotation adapted, not machine-translated)
- [ ] Entry follows the format: `**[Title](URL)** — Author/Org — *type, date* — annotation`
- [ ] Annotation says *why it belongs*, in 1–2 sentences, with quantified claims where they exist
- [ ] URL verified and publicly accessible (no dead links, paywalled content noted with ⚠️)
- [ ] Markers applied: 🆕 for 2025–2026 content, ⚠️ for caveats
- [ ] Placed in the most relevant section; cross-referenced instead of duplicated
- [ ] Section `Must-reads` line updated if this becomes a top pick
